title: Red Hill Brewery Secret Stash Weekend
summary: The brewery held its Secret Stash Weekend on 16 and 17 August 2025. No new edition date has been confirmed by the organiser.
priceRange: Ticketed entry (tastings priced separately; check website)
accessibilityNotes: Accessible parking; limited mobility path on sloped terrain; contact venue
weatherDependency: Outdoor event, weather-dependent; brewery has indoor covered areas
nearbyAttractions: Polperro Winery; Red Hill Truffles; Foxeys Hangout
suggestedItineraryPairing: Combine with Red Hill wine trail: Polperro; Foxeys; Red Hill Estate; consider Brewer's Cottage accommodation
editorVerdict: Wait for the brewery to announce a new edition before planning a visit.
editorNote: The brewery announced the 2025 weekend for 16 and 17 August. We found no official announcement for a 2026 or 2027 edition as of 23 September 2026. Earlier future dates on this page were estimates and have been withdrawn.
internalNotes: Official 2025 event notice: https://www.redhillbrewery.com.au/secret-stash-16th-17th-august/ . No 2026 or 2027 edition found on the brewery event pages as of 2026-09-23.
archivedReason: No organiser announcement for a 2026 or 2027 Secret Stash Weekend; prior future dates were estimates.
